summary: A turn where Nora looks several things up at once can no longer blow through its own limits and end up saying nothing at all.
details: Her per-tool limits are now counted while a lookup is still running, not only once it has finished — so a burst of lookups fired together is held to the same ceiling as the same lookups made one after another.
One real turn was lost to this: asked for a dinner place and a second venue for drinks, she made nine place lookups against a limit of four, ran out of room mid-turn, and replied with nothing.
limitations: Rare — it needs her to fire a large burst of lookups in one go, which she usually does not.
